body: Earnings announcements are a public statement of a company's profitability for a specific period of time, such as a quarter (90 days) or a year. Equities research analysts will issue estimates of the company's earnings numbers prior to its announcement date, which is generally set weeks or months in advance. They are comprehensive summaries of a publicly traded company's financial performance that offer a window into its operations and provide details regarding its ability to generate returns for shareholders in the future. Instead of points scored, assists, or rebounds, fans of a company will look at its revenue, expenses, profits, and other financial ratios to try and predict whether an investment will be a win or loss. Keep reading to learn more about the information on earnings reports and how this data can influence stock prices, investor confidence, and broader market trends. An earnings report offers a detailed breakdown of a company’s earnings—the profits it generates—over a specific period, usually quarterly or annually.
